test_name: Database Data Validation - Verify all 6 enum entries with correct values and match AC1
description: Verify that all 6 email notification category enum entries exist in database with correct Name and Description values matching story AC1 specifications exactly
preconditions: Database contains EmailNotificationGroupEnum table with data

steps.description: Retrieve all enum entries ordered by name
steps.action: Query DB: SELECT [Name], [Description] FROM EmailNotificationGroupEnum WHERE CreatedBy='PRODENG-22284' ORDER BY [Name]
Verify query result contains: Name='receivedCompletedNewAccounts', Description='New Accounts'
Verify query result contains: Name='receivedCompletedMoneyIn', Description='Money In'
Verify query result contains: Name='receivedCompletedStandingInstructions', Description='Standing Instructions'
Verify query result contains: Name='receivedCompletedInvestmentChanges', Description='Investment Changes and Journals'
Verify query result contains: Name='receivedCompletedWithdrawals', Description='Withdrawals and Bank Maintenance'
Verify query result contains: Name='receivedCompletedTerminations', Description='Terminations and Transfer out'
Compare all 6 returned records against story AC1 table for exact match - no typos, no missing entries, no incorrect values

expected_results.verification: All 6 enum entries are present in database

expected_results.assertion: All records match AC1 specification exactly
expected_results.verification: All 6 records match story AC1 specification exactly - no typos, no missing entries, no incorrect values

test_name: Database Data Validation - Verify total count and no duplicates
description: Verify that exactly 6 email notification enum entries created by PRODENG-22284 exist in the database with no duplicates

steps.description: Count all records created by PRODENG-22284
steps.action: Query DB: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count FROM EmailNotificationGroupEnum WHERE CreatedBy='PRODENG-22284'

steps.description: Count distinct enum names created by PRODENG-22284
steps.action: Query DB: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT [Name]) as distinct_names FROM EmailNotificationGroupEnum WHERE CreatedBy='PRODENG-22284'

expected_results.verification: No duplicate names exist (6 distinct records)

test_name: Database Data Validation - Verify CreatedBy and CreatedDate metadata
description: Verify that all 6 enum entries have correct CreatedBy='PRODENG-22284' and CreatedDate is set to current date

steps.description: Retrieve all enum entries with metadata
steps.action: Query DB: SELECT [Name], [CreatedBy], CAST([CreatedDate] as DATE) as CreatedDate_Only FROM EmailNotificationGroupEnum WHERE CreatedBy='PRODENG-22284' ORDER BY [Name]

expected_results.verification: All records have correct CreatedBy value

expected_results.assertion: All records have current date as CreatedDate
expected_results.expected_value: CreatedDate = Today's date for all 6 records
expected_results.verification: CreatedDate is today's date (no NULL values)

test_name: Database Data Validation - Verify no NULL values in required fields
description: Verify that all required fields (Name, Description, CreatedBy, CreatedDate) have non-NULL values for all 6 enum entries

steps.description: Query for any NULL values in required fields
steps.action: Query DB: SELECT [Name], [Description], [CreatedBy], [CreatedDate] FROM EmailNotificationGroupEnum WHERE CreatedBy='PRODENG-22284' AND ([Name] IS NULL OR [Description] IS NULL OR [CreatedBy] IS NULL OR [CreatedDate] IS NULL)

expected_results.assertion: No NULL values in required fields
expected_results.verification: All required fields have values for all 6 records
